Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 05/19/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Troubleshooting
-Regarding the reported issue, it has been observed that a "Missing Converter" error in DC2 has occurred again, along with error E17, which indicates an
Internal Communication Error
.
In such cases, the converter wiring might be loose. We recommend verifying the connections with the help of the troubleshooting document.
If all the wiring is properly secured, it is likely that one of the converters may be faulty or damaged.
The converter reporting the issue to the SCB is likely the one that needs replacement or further investigation.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
